name: PhotoCraft v0.6.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Motion Blur: 6x to 70x faster (one merged kernel applied over whole rows) by @Ar-maan05 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/902
* Applying a text data set re-renders the type layer instead of blanking it (#990) by @ianswope in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1025
* PSD: a spec-order mask record is not misread as Photoshop's order when that reading is implausible (#949) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1129
* ui.window.open: an invalid document index is an error, not a side effect by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1133
* fix(ui): remember previously applied New Guide Layout values by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1261
* fix(ui): allow removing the last polygonal lasso point by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1262
* PSD export: write empty layer and mask channels as raw by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1290
* Fix #1286: Delete and Fill Selection on the selection tools' right-click menu by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1331
* Part of #1275: the Studio themes show the Move tool's Auto-Select toggle by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1333
* Fix #1323: a Distort corner stops before the box folds over by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1332
* chore: remove accidentally committed fb-*.log files and ignore *.log by @ArianPashae in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1155
* Filter › Last Filter applies to the active layer, not the layer the filter first ran on (#1270) by @marcardenas in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1307
* Gradient tool: a handle dragged past the 10% scale floor stops; the other handle stays put (#1243) by @marcardenas in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1306
* fix(ui): prevent hidden guides from intercepting canvas input by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1268
* fix(ui): display configured Quick Export format in File menu by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1269
* fix(export): add WebP quality controls to Export Preferences by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1279
* PSD text fill: keep FillFlag so Photopea-edited text keeps its fill, carrying #1240 by @ragedotdev by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1368
* Free Transform: W/H and X/Y fields reach large documents, carrying #1295 by @marcardenas by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1340
* Select › Modify: Apply effect at canvas bounds, carrying #1296 by @marcardenas by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1339
* Layers panel: hovering a blend mode previews it live on the canvas (#970) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1081
* docs: craftrules is not public — say so instead of linking it (#493) by @bfenty in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/779
* i18n: fix pt-br label collisions (Feather/Diffuse, Liquify/Dissolve) by @RicSchonfelder in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/833
* Never crash on hostile numbers: LUT sizes, Quick Selection points, link group ids by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/869
* A PSD layer with bounds but no channel data no longer aborts on a 360 GB allocation (#755) by @ianswope in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/885
* New Document: a Clipboard preset with the clipboard image's size by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/891
* Layer copies are numbered: "Layer 1 copy 2", not "Layer 1 copy copy" by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/897
* file.new at 300000x300000 no longer fills ~360 GB of tiles before returning (#705) by @ianswope in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/900
* Divide wide slice rectangles without integer overflow by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/991
* Saturate layer-slice margins at coordinate limits by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/998
* image.crop rejects an origin or far edge that can't be moved within i32 instead of panicking (#959) by @mnmlyw in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1013
* Place Scale Marker: a document under 8 px tall returns an error instead of panicking (#932) by @mnmlyw in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1014
* Timeline: out-of-range duration and fps are rejected, and stepping never panics (#1009) by @mnmlyw in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1023
* Slices test: as_chunks for the fixed 3-wide rows (follow-up to #991) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1374
* gradient.fill.stop rejects an out-of-range index with BadParams instead of overflowing (#958) by @mnmlyw in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1000
* Link Layers allocates a group id that can't overflow (#961) by @mnmlyw in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1022
* Median, Dust & Scratches: run time grows linearly with the radius, identical output at 8, 16 and 32-bit (#498) by @Ar-maan05 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/901
* docs: refresh implemented tool status in the roadmap by @Streetblock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1205
* Options bar: the airbrush, smoothing options and symmetry buttons work (#1177) by @ChrisWaldenDev in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1214
* Startup: preserve the GPU backend after windowing errors by @liowald in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1228
* Brush Scatter: out-of-range amounts are rejected and dab rects can't overflow (#977) by @mnmlyw in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1034
* Space untimed stroke segments by distance when Spacing is off by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1036
* Variables: preserve Unicode when importing data-set CSV (#989) by @tiredIsa in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1062
* image.analysis.recordMeasurements: refuse an area too large to measure instead of overflowing by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1184
* Edit Contents switches to the already-open contents document by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1037
* Paste into a targeted layer mask (or channel) instead of making a new layer (#1035) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1078
* Absolute colorimetric refuses a zero or non-finite media white (#972) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1125
* Clone Stamp / Healing Brush: a far source is a bad-params error, not an out-of-bounds slice (#1111) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1165
* Keep the Background position lock after Flatten Image by @CQMHV in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1238
* Shape gradients: honour midpoints, opacity stops, offset, dither and align by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1321
* Holding a number key sets one digit's opacity, not a two-digit value (#953) by @ianswope in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1030
* Layers panel: Alt-click the line between two layers creates or releases a clipping mask (#967) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1066
* ⌘/Ctrl-scroll pans the canvas sideways; scroll bars always shown (#635, #620) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1069
* Nearest Neighbor: sample single source pixels on reductions without averaging (#1114) by @MokuLakshithReddy in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1141
* Fix: Resolve issue where various file formats save incorectly as a `.psd` by @Cyanoxide in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1178
* New adjustment and fill layers take the active selection as their mask (#1250) by @Pathos0925 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1282
* Tools leave hidden layers alone: painting or moving a hidden layer is refused (#571) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/872
* CI: ~1.6x faster runs (2.2x on Linux-only PRs), no more out-of-disk failures by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1075
* feat(ui): edit the Color panel's hex and RGB readouts by @roaldosulejmani in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1016
* Deep EXR: write the flattened pixel by layout, not a fixed RGBA quadruple by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1021
* Eyedropper cursor: a pipette instead of the crosshair when sampling by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1028
* Option flips Dodge/Burn and Blur/Sharpen for a stroke by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1038
* CPU effect maps: key fill layers by their cached pixels, drop opacity/visible by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1059
* fix(cli): report missing font fallbacks in run, info and convert by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1299
* Corpus: pin the deep OpenEXR test images and check them in CI (FILE-216-3, part of #216) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/881
* Selection tools: ⌘ moves like the Move tool; ⌘⌥ copies (pixels inside the selection, the layer outside) by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/896
* Layer comps: offsets that don't fit i32 are dropped with a warning instead of overflowing (#1017) by @mnmlyw in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1039
* MCP doc_save: bridge mode refuses headless-only options instead of saving with defaults by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1138
* Move tool: layers with effects that overhang the canvas drag ~2x faster (#761, #128) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/893
* Artboards: coordinates past the 32-bit range are rejected instead of overflowing (#931) by @mnmlyw in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1032
* Autosave: a thread that fails to start is reported, not a silent no-op by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1124
* Desktop: write log records to standard error and a rotating log file by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1143
* fix: resolve edge-case crashes, unbounded allocations, and UI sync defects by @buivanvu94 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1010
* UI Scale Auto keeps the system's fractional scale on 4K (#1072) by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1237
* raw: decode Nikon compressed NEF (lossless + lossy) by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1310
* Fix Drop Shadow angle synchronization and add a radial dial by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/882
* PSD notes: an icon position near i32::MAX saturates on save instead of overflowing (#939) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1176
* Improve Color Picker layout and spacing (#1188) by @shorbank in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1196
* Toolbar: the header chevron switches between one and two columns (#1197) by @prekabreki in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1200
* Find host CJK fonts inside Flatpak by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1204
* Select › Color Range: Photoshop's Sampled Colors model, Subtract from Sample and the eyedropper on the image by @Unemars in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1239
* PSD: preflight pattern allocations and reuse decoded buffers by @Streetblock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1242
* Fix #1271, fix #1316: Preferences › Interface › System Title Bar by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1344
* A non-Unicode command-line argument is a usage error, not a startup panic (#1108) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1168
* Fix transform cancellation undoing the wrong document by @CQMHV in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1170
* Fit Artboard on Screen: no i32 overflow for a board with large coordinates by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1181
* filter.cameraRaw: refuse an area too large to develop instead of overflowing by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1183
* PSD plane shuffles in bands; the document histogram computes off the UI thread by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1185
* Add Polish translation by @Powiadomienie in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1192
* Layer style: an Outside stroke at Fill below 100 % leaves the interior clear by @llduyll10 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/906
* Fix(text): keep tiny EngineData reals parseable (#979) by @cold-atom in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1085
* Delete with nothing selected deletes the selected layers, of any kind (#1077) by @metzmehard in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1087
* Keep empty selections empty for subtract and intersect by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1190
* Filters respect layer locks; render filters and Fill Path refuse a pixel-locked layer (#1102) by @prekabreki in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1195
* Relight: halo covers the blur reach, no silent no-op above 8 MP, box-Gaussian blur (follow-up to #735) by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/895
* Help › Search: clicking the search field keeps the menu open by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1027
* Preferences: reset a single shortcut or menu colour override (#988) by @tiredIsa in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1064
* Hand tool: 100%, Fit Screen and Fill Screen buttons, carrying #1314 by @rozaqabdul656 by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1363
* SVG opens as shape layers and places as a vector smart object (FILE-215-9, part of #215) by @ljkx in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1305
* Show Clone Stamp source preview inside the brush cursor by @Lime-3010 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1042
* Clear, Cut and Image › Adjustments refuse a pixel-locked layer (#1103) by @prekabreki in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1194
* PSD export parallel layer channels; shared proxy cache; banded CMYK export by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1230
* Optimize Mosaic by averaging each cell once per tile (45-117x speedup) by @optimalbytee in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1294
* Open camera raws in Camera Raw first (Open / Cancel) by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1309
* ORF: a file cut short inside IFD0 is malformed, not the compressed variant (#1008) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1090
* Refuse to save a .pcraft holding a NaN or infinite float, instead of writing one that never opens again (#1101) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1172
* channel.merge: reject a repeated source index instead of closing an unrelated document by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1179
* layer.delete keeps a document's last layer (#1107) by @prekabreki in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1189
* Paint Bucket and Gradient keep alpha on a transparency-locked layer (#1104) by @prekabreki in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1193
* Document tabs: elide and overflow into a » menu when they are too many (#1276) by @LordFarquaadtheCreator in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1293
* Embed PhotoCraft CLI Windows icon and version metadata by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/889
* Fix corrupted reduced canvas previews with separate mip render targets by @GamerWil26 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/892
* Fix Classic Gradient transparency and open the Gradient Editor by @jerrykimo in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/905
* i18n(pl): translate the strings that landed alongside the Polish catalog by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1426
* Regenerate docs/scorecard.md (139 preferences after #1016) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1435
* Fix #1272: a reassigned shortcut runs its new command by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1330
* Pen tablets: the pen works on Wayland (through Xwayland), macOS pressure fixes (#639, #759) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1070
* Content-Aware Fill: size error instead of a panic for a huge selection, carrying #1024 by @mnmlyw by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1409
* Fix radial blur sampling density (#515) by @agorevski in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/658
* Right-click Brush Preset picker picks presets like Photoshop (#615, #1031) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1080
* Brush tests: seams, hard edge, zero scatter and ABR tip colour (#213) by @reynold-hu in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1221
* Feature: Add incrementation with up/down arrow keys on numeric fields by @Cyanoxide in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1326
* codecs README: lossy WebP is written by the built-in VP8 encoder (#1352) by @ragtux in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1396
* Perspective Warp: replacing the planes mid corner drag ends the drag (#952) by @kayrockscreenprinting in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1398
* Puppet Warp: an expansion that empties the mesh is refused, not a panic (#951) by @kayrockscreenprinting in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1410
* Vibrance: Photoshop's Saturation and Vibrance, measured (linear light, 0.288 R + 0.712 G grey) by @Unemars in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1418
* Select › Modify refuses a negative radius instead of clamping it (#993) by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1274
* Rulers: right-click to switch the ruler unit by @jeremyfry in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1235
* Fix/1350 preserve active on save by @shmuelbiller1 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1416
* Zoom: the Zoom tool's click honours Zoom Clicked Point to Center (#204) by @reynold-hu in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1241
* Preferences: show Zoom Clicked Point to Center now that the Zoom tool reads it (follow-up to #1241) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1480
* feat(ui): auto-scroll Layers panel during layer drag and drop by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1298
* Preferences › Performance › Low Resolution Previews: live previews at full resolution when it's off by @Unemars in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1247
* Eyedropper: the comparison ring while sampling (#213) by @reynold-hu in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1227
* Type Tool: Ctrl/Cmd temporary transform handles while editing (#1091) by @remidesbois1 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1202
* i18n: translate the Fill dialog, layer style contours and Image Size "(was …)" by @ArthurViniciusBA1 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1291
* Pipette cursor test: Windows draws the precise crosshair itself (main is red on Windows) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1437
* Keep the active document when closing another tab by @CQMHV in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1148
* Cancel transforms in their originating document, carrying #1170 by @CQMHV by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1390
* Move several selected layers into a group in one step, carrying #1297 by @Ni-zav by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1403
* Regenerate generated docs after the latest community merges by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1489
* undo/redo report the step's damage instead of recompositing the whole canvas by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/810
* Color Lookup: keep the .cube input domain and reject the ones we cannot apply by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1130
* ui.set validates every field before applying the first one by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/820
* Red Eye tool in the J-group flyout by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1084
* Layered TIFF: the review changes of #672 (keep unknown blocks with their byte order, io behind the engine, fixture attribution) by @ljkx in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/835
* Advanced Blending: knockout, blend as group, transparency shapes, masks hide effects (FILE-215-16, part of #215) by @ljkx in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/903
* I18N: Localize startup notices and welcome text by @txiki739 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1094
* Lasso: Alt clicks add straight segments, releasing Alt closes the outline by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/888
* Layers panel: Alt-drag a row to copy the layer there, as in Photoshop by @bani4kaskashka in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1216
* fix(ui): wrap New Document preset titles inside their cards by @SckraT in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1401
* PSD type layers without pixels are rendered on import; PostScript font names resolve to the installed family by @diegochagas in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1406
* Curves: add black, gray, and white point eyedroppers by @mralonsocorona in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/873
* GPU startup: windowing errors keep the backend; a failed CPU start doesn't pin CPU, carrying #1228 by @liowald and #1145 by @shovel-kun by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1342
* Add layer and group color labels (#1283) by @shorbank in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1289
* Color Balance: Photoshop's slider double-click reset, wheel and arrow steps, Alt+Cancel Reset, Properties Reset and history by @Unemars in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1256
* Fix #1248: Create and Release Clipping Mask act on every selected layer by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1392
* Fix #1288: keep edits to a video frame when the playhead moves by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1395
* Dropdowns take the arrow keys once open, carrying #1324 by @rozaqabdul656 by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1341
* Move tool moves the selected pixels when there is a selection (#578) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1068
* Fix #1371: read large macOS display ids, keep ICC bytes out of the error by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1412
* Fix #1354: the macOS menu bar is modal under dialogs, like shortcuts by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1413
* Fix #1387: the Type tool's font, style and size controls show in every theme by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1414
* Selection tools: ⌥ with nothing selected draws a new selection (follow-up to #1190) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1364
* Fix #1380: the web build asks before leaving the page with unsaved work by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1424
* Camera Raw opens in a window of its own by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1361
* Export As: a scale that changes only the height is applied (#1353) by @ragtux in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1394
* New Document: a size typed in millimetres or another physical unit keeps its digits (#1147) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1378
* PNM: the file, not the header, bounds what a decode reserves (#1110) by @kayrockscreenprinting in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1365
* Select › Modify refuses a radius below the dialog's minimum, carrying #1391 by @MarekSpodBiedry by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1485
* Edit › Toolbar: hidden tools leave the toolbar, carrying #1376 by @MarekSpodBiedry by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1486
* Paint Bucket: All Layers samples the visible image, carrying #1386 by @harrisonoconnorhover by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1487
* Swatches: user swatch model with .aco/.ase import and export (FILE-215-14, part of #215) by @ljkx in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/886
* Regenerate generated docs after the latest community merges by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1518
* Toolbar test: qualify egui::Vec2 (ui-egui tests don't compile on main) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1519
* Large document: a notice explains a slow CPU fallback redraw (#1015) by @ianswope in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1427
* i18n: split "Light" — font weights get their own context, Camera Raw keeps the panel term by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1061
* Pattern Stamp tool in the S-group flyout by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/922
* Fix #1229: the Polygonal Lasso tool removes its last vertex on Backspace (follow-up to #1262) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1338
* Document tabs: elide and overflow into a » menu, carrying #1293 by @LordFarquaadtheCreator by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1367
* Fix #1381: selecting type on Wayland no longer deletes it by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1421
* File dialogs no longer freeze or crash the app (#673, #574) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1071
